text.aria-label: Title text 'Quantile score of the day-ahead forecast of six metered solar farms (A to F), mean over farms, 12 to 36 h leads, daylight half-hours with a usable UKV run. Dot: estimate (mean over five seeds for neural heads). Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.'
